title: Preservation of the preexisting occlusal plane and vertical dimension in subtotal maxillectomy reconstruction using Jaw-in-a-Day protocol
html: Maxillary reconstruction following oncologic resection requires the reestablishment of functional occlusion in the absence of conventional dentoalveolar reference landmarks. Although virtual surgical planning has improved precision in fibula free flap reconstruction, the maintenance of the planned occlusal relationship during maxillary Jaw-in-a-Day procedures remains technique-sensitive. This clinical report describes a digitally guided, prosthesis-centered workflow for immediate implant-supported rehabilitation after subtotal maxillectomy.
